title: Grateful Dead Live at Carter-Finley Stadium on 1990-07-10
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Currier, Transfer By Keo; AKGC451EB/CK1's > AKG 9V Phantom Power > Marantz PDM 430 > Probaly Dolby (Not Marked) > Tapes Maxell MX 100; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > No Dolby > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate Software To 24/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience recording captures a lively show with standout drums/space in the second set and Hornsby’s accordion highlight despite police interruptions.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally clear but starts out a bit pokey and has some patchy moments in the first set, plus noticeable audience noise. Musically the concert is praised for an impressive second‑set drum/space segment and Brent Hornsby’s accordion work, while the crowd’s interaction with police adds a memorable (if chaotic) atmosphere.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave 5‑star ratings and highlighted strong musical moments; recording quality is good with minor issues, leading to a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is pretty good overall but a little 'pokey' at the start and patchy in the first set; audience noise is noticeable and somewhat distracting.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as patchy yet basically great; second set deemed tremendous with unusually noteworthy drums/space, creating a strong overall flow despite the police incident.

band_member_comments.Keys: Positive mention of Brent Hornsby’s accordion playing, considered almost worth the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Second‑set drums/space unusually noteworthy, highlighted by reviewers.
